content: Goal: resolve what the mechanism contributes to the training objective. Read the task specification and the normative hyperbolic-geometry contract. Observed: the specification explicitly says the baseline reconstruction and commitment losses are unchanged and that there is no new loss term; the mechanism is an assignment/quantisation procedure (Sinkhorn/argmax/Karcher/epoch-statistic refresh), not an added penalty. Evidence: task text lines 'baseline reconstruction and commitment losses unchanged, no new loss term' and 'MECHANISM: None'; contract only fixes geometry operators, not an objective. Reasoning: therefore the only defensible per-item loss contribution of the mechanism itself is the zero vector; the assignment affects existing losses through the quantised vector, but adds no differentiable loss surface of its own. Open: write the zero-loss statements and matching torch module, and list the non-differentiable assignment surfaces as excluded.
